passages.source_title: Filter First: Salience-Guided Input Pruning for Faithful News Summarization
passages.text: Across the three news summarization benchmarks we evaluated, salience pre-filtering reduced the share of summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to the unfiltered summarizer (from 14.2% to 9.8% on average), while ROUGE-L changed by less than 0.5 points. The filter scores each source sentence with a lightweight classifier and removes sentences scoring below 0.35.
